scope: Implement the frozen candidate on a reviewed measurement long table without introducing a parallel clinical truth or unsafe dynamic evaluation.

issue.root_cause: The manifest could be validated and released but had no common constrained executor, allowing downstream implementations to make different object, modality, visibility, and missing-data choices.
issue.fix: Add a strict reviewed measurement-row contract and a whitelist-only candidate executor bound to the built-in engine hash at both release and computation.

failure_guards: exam and availability times must both be inside the frozen window
one measurement object, modality, protocol, and measurement version per patient series
identity and protocol reviews must both pass
missing, conflicting same-day, and insufficient observations remain not computable
measurement rows outside an explicit patient set are rejected
unknown row fields, including outcome injections, are rejected
patients without measurements remain explicit not-computable outputs
unsupported formulas and stale built-in engine hashes are rejected
open_blockers: IPMN-HARNESS-001 still requires raw-source replay; no MPD parser root cause is asserted.
Real measurement rows require source and clinical identity/protocol review before the executor can produce research outputs.
Outcome adjudication and isolated statistical release remain external review tasks.
